title: Holy Body Suppresses the Dao Fetus
summary: The Five-Colored Altar is long dead and the God-Beating Whip gets no reaction from it, which dashes hopes of returning to Earth for now. Hei Huang finds the Ten Thousand Dragon Nest, where Wu Shi once forged dragons, and Ye Fan picks the dragon pearl of a True Dragon Immortal Medicine before the tree flees and ancient beasts chase them out. Zifu Holy Land cultivators ambush them and are captured to work as 'miners'. Then the Zifu Holy Maiden Zi Xia (Four Poles), born with the innate True Dao Body, traps Pang Bo, Tu Fei and Hei Huang in her Mountain and River Painting. Ye Fan escapes it with the Great Void Technique, reveals his Dao Palace Level 5, and smashes her Heavenly Dao power with his bare hands to defeat and seal her. The captured disciples boast that their Holy Lord's trip to Purple Mountain is backed by a king, and Ye Fan realises the Divine King Jiang Taixu is in danger. He decides to warn the Jiang family in the Holy City and 'hold the chess pieces' himself.
